name: Marriott Executive Apartments Kuala Lumpur
short_description: New long-stay serviced apartments beside KLCC Park, offering studios to three-bedroom units with full kitchens and in-unit laundry, steps from the Petronas Twin Towers.
ai_summary: Marriott Executive Apartments Kuala Lumpur opened in August 2025 as the brand's largest Asia Pacific property outside China, with 353 serviced apartments spanning studios to three-bedroom units. Built for the Marriott Executive Apartments long-stay format, every apartment includes a residential-style kitchen with a full-size fridge and cooking equipment, a separate living and dining area, and an in-unit washer/dryer, making it suited to relocations, project assignments and extended family visits as well as shorter stays. The 37-floor tower sits at 17 Jalan Kia Peng in the KLCC precinct, a short walk from KLCC Park, the Petronas Twin Towers and Suria KLCC, with direct rail links nearby. On-site facilities include Bistro Kia Peng serving modern Malaysian cuisine, a 24-hour fitness centre, a lap pool, a kids' club and splash zone, and a rooftop event space with skyline views. Because the property is very new, independent feedback is still limited; early guest commentary is mixed, praising the spacious, new, well-equipped apartments and central location while noting that service consistency does not always match Marriott expectations at the price point. Travelers should treat any aggregate rating as an early, small-sample signal rather than a settled reputation.

faqs.question: Is Marriott Executive Apartments Kuala Lumpur open?
faqs.answer: Yes. The property opened on 14 August 2025 and is operating, with 353 serviced apartments ranging from studios to three-bedroom units in the KLCC district.

faqs.question: Do the apartments have kitchens and laundry for long stays?
faqs.answer: Yes. As a Marriott Executive Apartments property, every unit is designed for extended stays with a residential-style kitchen (full-size fridge and cooking equipment), separate living and dining space, and an in-unit washer/dryer.
